name: cog-snapshot-consistent-managed-weight-imports
instr:
Managed-weight imports must remain bound to the source versions they planned, so changing local, HTTP, or Hugging Face content cannot produce a mixed-version artifact. Planning, construction, persistence, status, and command output must share one coherent account of the imported source state. Stable imports must retain existing filtering, overrides, redirects, deterministic artifacts, progress presentation, and no-op lockfile behavior.

Every Source from github.com/replicate/cog/pkg/model/weightsource, including For, must acquire a deterministic SnapshotIdentity over its complete sorted inventory and open only bytes belonging to that SourceSnapshot.Inventory. Source.BeginSnapshot and Source.OpenSnapshot must report version conflicts as SnapshotChangedError, whose Error output omits credentials and response bodies while Unwrap preserves supported causes. PlanImport must retain declaration-ordered snapshots and override ownership so WeightBuilder.BuildFromPlan uses exactly the inventories behind planning without payload ingress, reinventory, or silent reacquisition. SnapshotPolicyStrict stops at the first conflict, while SnapshotPolicyRetryOnce abandons the whole attempt, reacquires every source once, and permits publication only from that coherent replacement set. Failed attempts must leave artifacts, accepted content, evidence, and any previous lock entry untouched. Successful lock entries persist LockSnapshotEvidence aligned with normalized source configuration; WeightStatus
